title: flashcards-hub
prompt:
Mobile screen (iPhone, 393pt wide, dark mode) for "NY RE Exam": the Flashcards hub, reached from the Study tab. Design concept "Wayfinding": the visual language of New York subway signage. Every syllabus topic is a colored circular route bullet with one bold character (red #DA291C "1"/"2", blue #0039A6 "A"/"C", green #00843D "4"/"6", orange #FF6319 "B"/"D", yellow #FCCC0A with dark text "N"/"R", purple #9B2A92 "7", lime #6CBE45 "G"); progress is drawn as a line with station dots. Everything else is quiet, native-iOS polish on a dark OLED canvas.
Typography: Helvetica Neue bold for headings and all numbers (tabular figures, tight -0.02em tracking), system UI for body text. Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no middle-dot separators, no arrows on buttons, no emoji.
Palette: canvas #090d16, surface #111725, raised #182033, hairline rgba(148,163,184,.16), ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go #10b981, stop #ef4444, caution #f59e0b, statute indigo #818cf8. Elevation by surface lightness, not shadows. Radius: 24 hero, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. Every tap target at least 44pt. Floating glass capsule tab bar at the bottom with 6 tabs (icon over label): Home, Study, Build, Stats, Mistakes, More.
1. Large-title header "Flashcards" with subtitle "1,128 cards from the 19 cram sheets".
2. Hero card (24 radius): "Due today" with a huge tabular "86" and a full-width green primary button "Review 86 cards". Under the button a Leitner box line drawn as a subway line with 4 stations labeled "New 640", "1 day 210", "3 days 180", "7 days 98", station dots sized by count.
3. Segmented control: "By chapter" / "Card type".
4. Grouped list of chapters (18 radius, hairline dividers): each row has a route bullet, the chapter name, a thin mastery bar, "42 of 61 learned" in secondary ink, and a chevron. Show 6 rows: License Law & Article 12-A, Law of Agency, Real Estate Math, Real Estate Finance, Human Rights & Fair Housing, Closing & Settlement.
5. Floating tab bar with Study active.
